objects.title: Harvest Supper on the Row
objects.location: Long tables, north end of the Row

poster.alt: A table of round crusty loaves
poster.name: 07-bread.jpg

objects.summary: One long table down the middle of the street, and everything on it grown or made within ten miles. Bring a plate from home, and stay for the fiddles.

objects.title: Midsummer Lantern Walk
objects.location: Top of the Row, by the old feed store

poster.alt: A wall of glowing paper lanterns in orange, gold and teal
poster.name: 01-lantern-wall.jpg

objects.summary: Bring a lantern or paint one here, then walk the Row after dark with the whole neighborhood. Paper, paint and candles are free while they last.

objects.title: Opening Night
objects.location: The whole Row, Mill Street to the rail spur

poster.alt: Star-shaped lanterns throwing patterns of light
poster.name: 02-star-lanterns.jpg

objects.summary: The first market of the season, with every stall, every lantern and the Mill Street Brass Band at 7. Kids paint paper lanterns for free at the top of the Row.

objects.title: Hot Sauce Throwdown

poster.alt: Crates of red, orange and green peppers
poster.name: 05-peppers.jpg

objects.summary: Twelve home cooks, one very brave panel of judges and all the cold milk you can hold. Tasting cups are a dollar, and every cup is a vote.
